sample.topic: Monthly store operations report of Vizney Coffee, a fictional US coffee chain (nine stores in California, Texas and Washington), built from the blocks of a Notion page (icon, title, properties, callout, toggle headings) and its database views (chart, table and board, calendar, tags and status pills, number bars) in one card and chart grammar

card.role: every figure, table and number widget: white with a 1px hair border and a 12px radius

surface.role: segmented-control track, period pill, hover band behind a bar or a row (gray-200, surface-neutral)

surface-2.role: workbench side panel, calendar days outside the month (gray-100)

callout.role: the callout block that carries the lede (the product's callout background)

tab.role: the selected view tab: rgba(33,27,23,.05) on white

ink.role: titles, key figures, table values, the current month tick, the target line, the toast (gray-900)

text-2.role: subtitles, notes, figure labels, values beside end labels (gray-600, 6.5:1 on white)

muted.role: property names, table headers, axis ticks, unselected tabs (gray-500, 4.7:1 on white: the lightest gray allowed for small text, and only on white; use text-2 on gray or tinted surfaces)

mark.role: gray marks that are not text: the comparison line, other regions' lines (gray-400)

hair.role: card borders, dividers, dotted gridlines, chart baselines (the product's border-primary)

hair-2.role: table row and column rules, empty bar tracks: rgba(42,28,0,.07) on white

accent.role: the UI blue of notion.com: primary button, links, focus. Data takes its own blue step, #2783de

accent-hover.role: primary button hover; secondary button text

good.role: favourable change, text only (notion.com text-success, 4.9:1 on white)

bad.role: unfavourable change and a missed target, text only (red-700, 7.1:1 on white; text-error #f64932 is only 3.6:1)

validation.tool: dataviz validate_palette.js (OKLab), on the white card #ffffff where every chart sits
validation.categorical: blue #2783de (the product palette's blue accent, the colour Notion's chart view and its dashboard illustrations lead with), orange #dd5b00 (notion.com orange-600) and green #46a171 (the product's green accent) pass every check, all pairs: worst CVD ΔE 9.8 (deutan, green↔orange), blue against the others 20.1 or more; normal vision 20.8 or more. Contrast 3.90, 3.77 and 3.18:1, so every mark clears 3:1. The data blue is one step apart from the UI blue #0075de, which stays on buttons, links and focus
validation.other: #c7c6c4 is the gray the product's chart view gives a gray category; neutral by design (lightness band and chroma floor do not apply). Against the three hues: CVD 19.6 or more, normal vision 21.8 or more. At 1.71:1 it always has a second cue: a 2px white gap between segments, value labels and a table
validation.comparison: #a39e98 against blue: CVD 16.5 (protan), normal 19.8; 2.66:1, so it is always dashed (6 4) and labeled at its end
validation.sequential: one blue hue around the subject (#7db1ea, near the chart view's blue #5e9fe8, to #1d4677): monotone lightness, every gap ≥ 0.06, light end 2.25:1, hue spread 4°. Cell text is ink on the two light steps (7.8 and 5.7:1) and white on the three dark steps (5.0, 6.9 and 9.6:1)
validation.diverging: arms #ff8a33→#ab4a00 and #7db1ea→#1d4677 each pass the ordinal checks (light ends 2.35 and 2.25:1, hue spread 8° and 3°); poles CVD 18.8 (protan), normal 27.0; the midpoint #dfdcd9 is neutral
validation.status: good #14832b 4.87:1 and bad #b01601 7.09:1 as text on white, but they do not separate for deutan vision (ΔE 4.3): status is never color alone — a change keeps its sign and comparison words, and status pills keep their labels
validation.tags: status-pill dots #46a171 · #d8a32f · #e56458 come straight from the product (CVD 6.2, legal only with the label beside them, which pills always carry); tag text on its tag background is 5.8:1 or more

code.note: notion.com's code tokens (keyword blue, string green, function and number red) stepped down to ≥ 4.5:1 on white; inline code is red on a gray chip, as in a Notion page

sans.role: everything: Inter stands in for NotionInter; notion.com's Korean pages load no Korean webfont, so Korean uses Pretendard

mono.role: code only (notion.com's iA Writer Mono is built on IBM Plex Mono)

rows: page head: icon, finding title and properties 7 · number widgets 2 × 2 5; callout 12; contents
Sales: Figure 1 (7) · Figure 2 (5); Table 1 (12) with Table and Board views
Operations: Figure 3 calendar (7) · Figure 4 (5); Figure 5 (7) · Figure 6 (5)
How it's built: three steps, then the window (package 240px · figure and checks · code)

tableau.fonts: Tableau Book for text; Inter only if it is installed on every viewing machine and the server
